layout: page-major: 8 pages of 128 bytes a frame, each byte a column of 8 pixels, bit 0 the top
about: RIFT's start-up animation (owner, 2026-11-17; v0.21 2026-11-23): three endoskeletons drum around a campfire, the camera tilts to the stars, the smoke gathers into RIFT in block letters, which then drip and decompose. Rendered by tools/anim/rift_anim3d.py (a small 3D renderer, Bayer-dithered to one bit); 80 frames, 128 x 64.
